text: **PHPCompatibility and trim():** since its PHP 8.6 rule, every one-argument `trim()`, `ltrim()` or `rtrim()` fails `composer check` (the default characters gain `\f`). Pass `" \n\r\t\v\0"` explicitly. Found 2026-11-18 in mono-build-tools (189 calls) and mono-build-standards; modules hit it at their next `composer update`.
**Git Bash heredocs lose backslashes:** code with `\\` or `\s` written through a heredoc (also python or php code inside it) arrives broken. Write such code with the Write or Edit tool.

**A grep in an && chain hides a failed check:** `composer check | grep -E "failed|OK" && git commit` commits on failure, because grep finds "failed". Run the check alone and commit only on exit code 0.

**Demo deploys and crawlers:** every deploy clears the PrestaShop cache; a crawler on faceted-search pages (seen from Meta's IP range, 2026-11-17) then keeps the 8 PHP workers busy rebuilding it and the demo answers 504 for minutes. A VPS snapshot at the same time slows it further and the deploy check rolls back.

**Sales shop product create gives HTTP 500:** the shop's `override/classes/Product.php` (line 82) reads `php_self`, which the webservice has not. The product is created anyway: fill it with `ps-module publish shop --update`, check with a dry run first so there are no duplicates.

**Bootstrap utilities in core markup are !important:** classes like `d-flex` on PrestaShop's own back-office markup use `!important`, so a module's override needs `!important` too, scoped to its grid id (`#<grid>_grid ...`). Found in heavencartjourney 1.4.1.

**Grid row-link classes are translated:** PrestaShop builds `grid-<name>-row-link` from the translated action name, so a selector on it works only in English. Select on the href or on `#<grid>_grid` instead, and test the back office once in a second language. Found in heavencartjourney 1.4.0.

**Cloudflare cache purge fails with 401:** since 2026-11-17 the purge after `publish docs` / `publish demo` is refused; the Cloudflare API token in the workspace .env is wrong or expired. The publish itself succeeds; purge by hand until the token is replaced.
